title: Ex-Marine Robert Gilman, Freed by Russia After 4 Years in Prison, Arrives in the U.S.
summary_full: Russia released Robert Gilman on “a humanitarian basis,” President Trump said. Mr. Gilman’s family had said he was in dire physical condition.
